notes.title: 1.5 beta available
notes.content:
We have just uploaded release candidate 1 (RC1) of Ittle Dew 1.5 to Steam Beta.

To access, right click on Ittle Dew in your Steam Library, select Properties, then go to the Betas tab. Enter password "FrogFoxBlueberryDeer", check it, then select the beta branch from the dropdown.

What's new:
* Svenska!
* Nerfed Ultra Fishbunjin 3000
* Minor bugfixes

Those of you that have reported black screens and crash bugs, please try this version out and see if it fixes your problem!
xoxo

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.content:
We just updated Ittle Dew with a completely new, spooky dungeon - called Compst Crypt! It has all-new enemies, graphics and an Achievement. This update is free and permanent for all buyers.

We're also including a bunch of bugfixes!

1.1.0 Changelog
Bug fixes:
  - Game no longer slows down when the FPS drops below 60, nor speeds up when above 60
  - Itan boss fight should crash less (hopefully not at all)
  - Game should no longer freeze if the ghost catches Ittle at just the wrong point
  - Pressing unexpected buttons does not cause Ittle to move
  - Input remapping names are more descriptive

New stuff:
  - All new dungeon: Compost Crypt
  - Two new enemies: Rotnip and Carcactus
  - New Achievement: Compost Crypt Completed
